blocks.text: Discover the power of our state-of-the-art laser hair removal device, designed to provide you with long-lasting hair reduction.
blocks.html: Discover the power of our state-of-the-art laser hair removal device, designed to provide you with long-lasting hair reduction.

Tired of the endless cycle of shaving, waxing, and plucking? Discover the revolutionary Diolaze by InMode, a cutting-edge laser hair removal system now available in Calgary. This advanced technology utilizes the gold standard wavelength to effectively reduce and ultimately eliminate unwanted hair on virtually any area of your body. What sets our device apart? Its exceptionally large treatment surface area means faster sessions, while the integrated built-in cooling surface ensures your comfort throughout the process. Say hello to a smoother, more confident you, without the irritation and inconvenience of traditional hair removal.

blocks.text: Why Choose Diolaze at Our Calgary Clinic?
blocks.html: Why Choose Diolaze at Our Calgary Clinic?

Imagine the freedom of silky-smooth skin without the daily or weekly maintenance. Our Diolaze treatments can be applied to virtually any area you desire, from delicate spots like the upper lip and chin to larger areas such as the full back and legs. Whether you're looking for a touch-up or a complete transformation, we offer flexible pricing options to suit your needs:

items: Single Treatments: Perfect for targeting specific areas or trying out the Diolaze experience.
Treatment Series: Achieve optimal, long-lasting results with our cost-effective series of treatments.
Multiple Treatment Areas: Enjoy significant savings when you choose to treat multiple areas. Explore our comprehensive list of options and pricing on our convenient booking site.

blocks.text: Your Journey to Permanent Hair Reduction:

blocks.html: While individual results may vary based on factors such as hair color, hair type, treated body area, and your unique skin tone, most of our Calgary clients experience significant hair reduction after just 6 to 8 sessions with Diolaze. Our experienced technicians will assess your individual needs and create a personalized treatment plan to maximize your results.

We believe that long-term hair removal shouldn't break the bank. That's why we offer competitive series pricing for 6 treatments per area or a combination of areas, providing you with exceptional value on your journey to smooth skin. Even if you've had previous laser hair removal treatments elsewhere or it's been a while, our maintenance packages of 4 treatments are a smart way to keep those unwanted hairs at bay.
Ready to experience the Diolaze difference? Call our clinic at (403) 454-5607 or schedule a Laser Hair Removal Patch Test online.

Please note that a consultation is recommended prior to treatment to determine candidacy. If you have already undergone previous treatments or feel you would qualify, please call the clinic and we can book you in for a consultation and treatment on the same day.
